intro: Qingdao is a marine listening city first and everything else second. Jiaozhou Bay carries container and bulk traffic, the Olympic Sailing Centre keeps recreational VHF busy through the summer, and the coastline from Yantai round to Rizhao gives you clear over-water propagation that reaches much further than anything inland. One caution specific to this coast: it is a major naval area, so listen freely but do not transmit.
introz: 青岛首先是一座海事收听城市，其余都排在后面。胶州湾有集装箱和散货船流量，奥帆中心让夏季的游艇 VHF 一直很热闹，而从烟台到日照的海岸线提供了越海传播条件，覆盖距离远超内陆。这一带有个需特别注意的地方：这里是重要海军区域，可以自由收听，但请不要发射。

stations.z: 海事 16 频道 · 遇险与呼叫
stations.d: The single most useful frequency in Qingdao. Pilots, container ships, fishing fleets and the Maritime Safety Administration. Excellent from Xiaoyushan, the Zhanqiao pier or anywhere along the Badaguan shore.
stations.dz: 青岛最有用的一个频率：引航员、集装箱船、渔船队和海事局。在小鱼山、栈桥或八大关一带海岸收听效果极佳。

stations.z: 青岛船舶交通管理 12 频道
stations.d: Vessel Traffic Service for the bay approaches. Scan 156.300–156.800 to find the working channel in use.
stations.dz: 负责胶州湾进出口的船舶交通管理。扫 156.300–156.800 找当前工作频道。

stations.z: 海事 72 频道 · 游艇与帆船
stations.d: Qingdao is China's sailing capital. During regattas and through the summer the recreational channels carry race committees, coach boats and cruisers coordinating. Listen from Fushan Bay.
stations.dz: 青岛是中国的帆船之都。赛事期间和整个夏季，游艇频道上都是裁判船、教练艇和巡航船在协调。在浮山湾一带收听。

stations.z: 海事 68 频道 · 游艇
海事 06 频道 · 船间通话
stations.d: Fishing crews talk to each other here more than anywhere else. Rarely quiet at dawn.
stations.dz: 渔船之间主要在这里通话，清晨几乎从不安静。

stations.d: The newer airport inland from the city, opened in 2021 and built as a regional hub. Set AM and sweep the tower range.
stations.dz: 位于市区内陆方向的新机场，2021 年启用，定位为区域枢纽。设为 AM 后扫塔台频段。

stations.d: Coastal enroute sectors, with traffic tracking up and down the Yellow Sea and across to Korea and Japan.
stations.dz: 沿海航路扇区，可听到沿黄海南北飞行以及往韩国、日本方向的航班。

stations.n: 公众对讲机 — sweep all 20 channels
stations.z: 公众对讲机 · 20 个信道全扫
stations.d: Port operations, beach management, tour boats and the summer crowd control around Zhanqiao all use this band.
stations.dz: 港区作业、海滨管理、观光船以及夏季栈桥一带的人流疏导都在用这个频段。

stations.d: Quieter end of the band if you want to use it yourself with a 409 MHz radio.
stations.dz: 频段较安静的一端，如果你自己用 409 MHz 电台，适合选这里。

stations.n: Naval and public security — not receivable
stations.z: 海军与公安 · 收不到
stations.d: Qingdao hosts significant naval facilities. Military communications are encrypted, and public security runs digital PDT. Do not attempt to monitor military traffic, and under no circumstances transmit near a naval area.
stations.dz: 青岛有重要的海军设施。军事通信已加密，公安使用数字 PDT。请勿尝试监听军事通信，更不要在海军区域附近发射。

stations.d: Conventional freight and passenger operation west toward Jinan still uses analog dispatch radio in the 450 MHz band. Scan near the yards.
stations.dz: 往西通向济南的普速货运和客运仍在 450 MHz 使用模拟调度电台。在货场附近扫描。

stations.n: 青岛交通广播 — traffic radio
stations.d: Bridge and tunnel conditions across Jiaozhou Bay, which matters more here than in most cities.
stations.dz: 胶州湾跨海大桥和隧道的通行状况，在这里比多数城市更重要。

stations.d: Sweeping the band on the coast picks up Yantai, Weihai and sometimes Dalian across the water, which is a nice demonstration of how well VHF travels over the sea.
stations.dz: 在海边整段搜索可以收到烟台、威海，有时还能越海收到大连——这很好地说明了 VHF 越海传播有多好。

stations.n: Medium wave at night — Korea and Japan
stations.z: 夜间中波 · 韩国与日本
stations.d: The Shandong coast at night is one of the better medium wave DX locations in China. Korean and Japanese stations come in strongly across the Yellow Sea. Remember the 9 kHz channel spacing.
stations.dz: 夜间的山东沿海是中国较好的中波远距离接收地点之一，韩国和日本的电台越过黄海信号很强。注意 9 kHz 间隔。

stations.d: From Fushan or Laoshan the over-water path gives a handheld unusual reach along the coast.
stations.dz: 在浮山或崂山，越海路径让手台沿海岸的覆盖距离格外可观。

stations.d: A clear sea horizon to the east makes the coastal hills good for satellite passes.
stations.dz: 东面是开阔海平线，沿海山丘很适合接收卫星过顶。
